question: What power is attributed to the vidyā when uttered with its specified ending?
premises: The vidyā is uttered ending in ṅe
This vidyā is identified as the subject
It brings the three worlds under control
inference: The properly uttered vidyā possesses the power to subdue the three worlds.
uncertainties: Internal sandhi in ṅe'ntām and vidyeyaṃ noted but tokens kept fused as given
plain_english: Having uttered it ending in ‘ṅe’, this vidyā brings the three worlds under control.
